title: Version policy matrix and dependency heatmap for inference surfaces
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Scope: produce a single, actionable version policy matrix and a visual dependency heatmap that covers the four inference surfaces (serving runtime, public API, official SDKs, and Redwood Console). The matrix must: (1) define supported version ranges per channel (stable, LTS, legacy), (2) specify compatibility guarantees (binary, contract, schema), (3) enumerate required upgrade actions for cross-surface changes, and (4) include risk bands and recommended rollout gates. The heatmap should surface coupling between components (e.g., runtime kernel changes -> SDK wire format -> console metrics parsing) and annotate which teams own mitigations and automated checks. Deliverables: CSV policy matrix, Confluence design doc with diagrams, generated dependency SVG, CI validators (release-lint rule), and a runtime-side compatibility test harness.
updates: 2026-03-01: Ticket created. Initial problem statement drafted after release retro highlighted several cross-surface upgrade incidents.
2026-03-03: Scoping sync with PM and Console lead. Agreed to include SDK pinning recommendations and a minimal fallback policy for hosted API.

2026-03-05: Architecture review with Runtime and SDK owners. Trade-off discussion: strict semver enforcement vs channel-based toleration. Decided on hybrid: semantic versioning as primary, channel labels for operational guarantees.
2026-03-07: Prototype heatmap generated from dependency graph (service configs + repo deps). Identified two high-coupling areas: KV cache protocol and rollout fingerprinting headers.

2026-03-09: Implementation plan: (A) author matrix CSV schema, (B) add release-lint checks to CI, (C) create a dashboard in Console to surface upgrade risk per customer, (D) write compatibility validation harness for runtime API surface.
2026-03-11: Review feedback from Security: request to add KMS/HSM upgrade path notes and explicit audit log requirements. Added to matrix as a security row.
2026-03-12: Blocker discovered: test infra for multi-version runtime clusters missing; raise infra request (ENG-47218).
notes: Decisions so far: hybrid semver+channel model; matrix rows will include: surface, min_supported, max_supported, compatibility_contract (wire|binary|schema), recommended_rolling_strategy, required_rollout_gates, test_suite_reference. Risk bands: green (no migration), amber (soft-deprecation tests), red (breaking; requires migration tooling + doc). Next steps: finalize CSV schema, schedule a rollout-gates workshop with Solutions and Platform, and spin up multi-version clusters in QA (infra request).
